name: chess-hive-electron
description: Decentralised peer-to-peer chess — no server required
author: Ayoub Themry

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd ReactChessDemocracy && npm install && cd ..
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: tsc && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=true electron .
scripts.build:release: npm run build:core && npm run build:react && npm run build && npm run dist
scripts.kill: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Name 'Chess Democracy' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force release -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
scripts.dist: npm run kill && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
